glosses: to entertain, to keep entertained (typically of children or those regarded as similarly demanding)

examples.text: Der Musiker schrieb spooky Soundtracks für Good Time und Uncut Gems, zwei Filme, mit denen die Regisseure Josh und Benny Safdie sowohl Fans von Adam Sandler als auch Poweruser der Internet Movie Database bespaßen konnten.
examples.translation: The artist wrote spooky soundtracks for Good Time and Uncut Gems, two movies with which directors Josh and Benny Safdie were able to keep both Adam Sandler fans and Internet Movie Database power users entertained.
examples.english: The artist wrote spooky soundtracks for Good Time and Uncut Gems, two movies with which directors Josh and Benny Safdie were able to keep both Adam Sandler fans and Internet Movie Database power users entertained.

glosses: Divertir.
auf seichte Weise amüsieren oder belustigen

examples.text: Ein Hotelmitarbeiter wollte uns den ganzen Tag mit seichten Spielen bespaßen.
Dabei sollen Kinder und Eltern gemeinsam Freude haben, und das Kind soll weder die Eltern noch die Eltern das Kind »bespaßen«.
Oder aber er tröstete und bespaßte mit seinen Kapriolen seine Freundinnen aus dem Bordell.

glosses: to amuse (someone); to engage the attention of agreeably

examples.text: to entertain friends with lively conversation
The motivational speaker not only instructed but also entertained the audience.

glosses: to have someone over at one's home for a party or visit

examples.text: They enjoy entertaining a lot.
Be not forgetful to entertain strangers[…]

glosses: to receive and take into consideration; to have a thought in mind

examples.text: The committee would like to entertain the idea of reducing the budget figures.
to entertain a proposal
I am not here going to entertain so large a theme as the philosophy of Locke.
A rumour gained ground, — and, however absurd, was entertained by some very sensible people.

glosses: to take or keep in one's service; to maintain; to support; to harbour; to keep

examples.text:
Intreat 'em fair, and give them friendly speech,
And seem to them as if thy sins were great,
Till thou hast gotten to be entertain'd.
You, sir, I entertain for one of my hundred.

glosses: to meet or encounter, as an enemy

examples.text: O noble English, that could entertain with half their forces the full pride of France
Penalty for entertaining a Deserter

glosses: to lead on; to bring along; to introduce

examples.text: to baptize all nations, and to entertain them into the services and institutions of the holy Jesus

glosses: to help; to assist; to answer a phone call
Entertainment; pleasure.

glosses: Reception of a guest; welcome.

examples.text: But neede, that answers not to all requests, / Bad them not looke for better entertayne […]

glosses: Détourner de ce qui préoccupe, fatigue, ennuie en amusant, en récréant.

examples.text: Dès que tout fut en ordre, les industrieux animaux [les castors] prirent un moment de récréation, se poursuivant dans l’étang, plongeant au fond de l’eau ou jouant à la surface, en frappant à grand bruit l’eau de leurs queues. […]. Tandis que les premiers se divertissaient ainsi, deux autres membres de la communauté parurent.

glosses: Détourner d’une occupation, d’un dessein.

examples.text: Divertir quelqu’un de ses travaux. - Il avait formé un projet peu raisonnable, je l’en ai diverti.

Ces gronderies, qui eurent un funeste résultat pour Pierrette, ramenèrent les deux célibataires vers l’ancienne ornière commerciale d’où leur établissement à Provins les avait divertis, et où leur nature allait s’épanouir et fleurir.
Les larmes d’Yves jaillirent enfin, et Jean-Louis en éprouva du soulagement. Lui, demeurait calme, – diverti de sa douleur.

glosses: Faire diversion.
Soustraire, dérober, s’approprier illégitimement.

examples.text: Il avait diverti plusieurs des effets de la succession. - Divertir des papiers importants. - On l’accuse d’avoir diverti les fonds qui lui étaient confiés.
